The hardening release after a full code and security review (with a counter-review) of 2.1.0. **Every user of 2.x
should upgrade**: in 2.x, privacy policies on members of structs and of `[JsonDerivedType]` subtypes did nothing —
those values went into the change feed in clear text — and an MCP agent chose the tenant it read. 3.0 is **breaking**;
most of it fails loudly at restore or startup rather than at run time. The full list, with every change, is in the
[changelog](https://github.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#300-2026-10-31).

Upgrade notes — the short version of [Upgrading from 2.x](https://github.com/papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#upgrading-from-2x):

- **Update all Papuma packages together.** They depend on each other exactly (`[3.0.0]`); mixing versions is a
  restore error (`NU1107`). The new package `Papuma.Kernel.Core` arrives by itself.
- **Startup refuses what would do nothing or lose data**, naming each case: a policy attribute on a collection's
  element type, more than one policy attribute on a property, an `object` property without a policy or `.Track()`,
  an interface or abstract property type without `[JsonDerivedType]`, a handler name with `:`. A model with
  `[TrackHash]` needs a hash key of your own — the published test key of `Papuma.Kernel.Testing` is refused.
- **MCP: set `ScopeResolver`** in `WithPapumaKernel`, or the document tools refuse every call. History and
  correlation respect `ExposeToMcp()`; lookups by keys under a privacy policy are refused.
- **Enum values are stored by name** (`"Paid"`, not `1`). Old documents still read and are rewritten on their next
  save; a key on an enum field finds such a document only after that save.
- **Handlers: filter with `change.Is<Order>(store.Model)`**, not `change.DocumentType == nameof(Order)` — the record
  carries the logical name, which stops being the class name once a type declares one.

Highlights:

- **Policies act wherever a value is stored.** Struct members (also `Nullable<T>`) and `[JsonDerivedType]` subtype
  members are scanned under the property's path; the data inventory lists them. Data written by 2.x stays in the feed
  as it was — review it with `DataInventory.Build(model)` and clean up with `RedactHistoryAsync` (docs/gdpr.md).
- **Polymorphic documents read back from PostgreSQL** — `jsonb` reorders keys, and the `$type` discriminator no longer
  came first.
- **MCP scope binding.** `PapumaMcpOptions.ScopeResolver` decides the scope per call (for HTTP: the request's), the
  agent's `tenantId` can only repeat it. `McpScopeResolvers.TrustToolArgument` keeps the 2.x behaviour for an
  operator-only endpoint, as a deliberate choice. ADR-016 §6.
- **Dashboard:** a stored XSS through exception messages is fixed; page and data endpoint send a strict CSP.
- **Feed workers:** shutdown keeps progress, a failing handler no longer stops the others, no hot loop on a faulted
  cycle, one feed engine per backend instead of four copies.
- **SQLite:** `OpenReadSession` returns a `SqliteReadSession` that takes no write lock (under WAL) and has no write
  method — for screens that stay open; a write blocked by another session fails after 5 s instead of about 31 s; the
  feed warns when a batch will be redelivered.
- **Packaging:** `Papuma.Kernel.Core` is a package of its own instead of being embedded in three packages; NuGet audit
  gates the build; all sources and versions are central (`nuget.config`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `global.json`).
- **Release pipeline:** build and publish are separate jobs, the OIDC token is only reachable from publish, every
  action is pinned to a commit SHA, the tag must match the packages exactly, and the packages carry a build
  provenance attestation.

Packages: `Papuma.Kernel`, `Papuma.Kernel.Core` (new), `Papuma.Kernel.Local`, `Papuma.Kernel.AspNetCore`,
`Papuma.Kernel.Mcp`, `Papuma.Kernel.Testing`, `Papuma.Kernel.FSharp` — all 3.0.0, .NET 10, PostgreSQL ≥ 18 for the
PostgreSQL kernel.

Verify a package's provenance: `gh attestation verify Papuma.Kernel.3.0.0.nupkg --repo papumabiz/Papuma.Kernel`.
